description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

description: Binghatti Spectre is a mixed-use development by Binghatti, presented under the concept "A Presence Beyond the Visible." The project comprises two towers of contrasting heights rising above a shared podium base, with a sculptural, fluid silhouette. Residence formats include studios, apartments, and Royal Suites in one-, two-, and three-bedroom configurations, alongside dedicated office and retail space. The development is positioned as a contemporary residential and commercial destination, complemented by panoramic city views. Residents have access to a dedicated pool for adults and children, together with a yoga and aerobics platform and a paddle and tennis court for active pursuits. A children's play area sits alongside family sitting and social nooks, while wellness facilities and lounge sitting platforms provide space for relaxation. The development also includes an open lawn, a dedicated jogging and sprint lane, and activity tables with a ping-pong table for recreation. Interior layouts range from efficient studios to expansive three-bedroom residences, with the largest configurations featuring a private pool and a terrace open to the sky, plus dedicated laundry space. Rooms are organized around distinct living, dining, and kitchen zones, with master suites in the larger units. The residences feature modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout, and are delivered unfurnished. Location description and benefits Al Jaddaf is a vibrant and rapidly developing neighborhood located on the banks of Dubai Creek. Known for its strategic location, Al Jaddaf is situated between Dubai's old town and the bustling modern hubs of Downtown Dubai and Business Bay. This unique positioning makes it a desirable area for both residents and businesses, offering seamless connectivity to key parts of the city via major highways like Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road, as well as easy access to public transport, including the Dubai Metro and Creek ferry services. Its proximity to Dubai International Airport further enhances its appeal as a convenient and well-connected neighborhood. The area is a blend of tradition and modernity, reflecting Dubai's rich cultural heritage while embracing contemporary urban development. Al Jaddaf is home to the iconic Dubai Frame, a major landmark that offers breathtaking views of the city, and the historical Dubai Creek, which retains its charm as a hub of the city's maritime and trade history. The area also features the Jameel Arts Centre, a cultural hotspot showcasing contemporary art and fostering creative expression, making Al Jaddaf an attractive destination for art and culture enthusiasts. Al Jaddaf offers a well-rounded lifestyle with a growing array of residential, commercial, and leisure options. It features a variety of modern apartment complexes, many of which boast waterfront views and state-of-the-art amenities. The neighborhood's emphasis on green spaces, including the landscaped walkways along the creek, promotes outdoor activities and a healthy lifestyle. With upcoming developments and a focus on enhancing community living, Al Jaddaf continues to grow as one of Dubai's most promising and sought-after residential and cultural hubs.

description: Exclusive Waterfront Apartments with Wynn Casino Views in Ras Al Khaimah Ras Al Khaimah, the northernmost emirate of the UAE, is renowned for its stunning coastline, majestic mountains, and rapidly growing luxury real estate market. This dynamic destination blends rich cultural heritage with modern infrastructure, offering residents and investors a high-quality lifestyle. One of the most anticipated developments in the region is the Wynn Al Marjan Island, the UAE's first integrated gaming and resort destination. Set to open in 2027, this mega-project will feature a world-class casino, luxury hotels, fine dining, and entertainment experiences, making Ras Al Khaimah a premier global tourism and investment hub. With its breathtaking waterfront views, expanding infrastructure, and promising economic growth, Ras Al Khaimah is quickly becoming one of the most sought-after locations in the UAE for luxury living and investment opportunities. are conveniently located just 3 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 6 minutes from Al Marjan Island Beach and Al Hamra Marina & Yacht Club, 13 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah Corniche, 15 minutes from Wynn Casino, 25 minutes from Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, 45 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and 55 minutes from Downtown Dubai. Designed as an exclusive waterfront community, this development seamlessly blends modern luxury with natural tranquility. It features five elegant 18-story towers, each offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Wynn Al Marjan Island. Inspired by traditional Arabic architecture, the exteriors combine earthy tones and contemporary design, creating a visually striking yet serene environment. Residents can enjoy direct sea access and an extensive array of world-class amenities, including a scenic promenade, state-of-the-art fitness center, coworking spaces, an entertainment room, multiple swimming pools, a kids' play area, jogging tracks, and championship padel tennis courts. For outdoor enthusiasts, lush parks, a dedicated pet-friendly zone with grooming services, and barbecue areas enhance the community's appeal. The development is further enriched by its proximity to the Royal Yacht Club, Al Hamra Golf Club, and an array of luxury hotels, fine dining, and high-end retail outlets, ensuring a sophisticated yet relaxed lifestyle. The project offers a meticulously designed collection of residences, including spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, each crafted for modern comfort and elegance. Interiors are thoughtfully planned with open layouts that maximize natural light, featuring floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning sea views. High-quality finishes and premium materials create a sophisticated ambiance, complemented by neutral, earthy tones inspired by the surrounding landscape. Each residence is equipped with fitted wardrobes, ensuring ample storage space, and a fully integrated kitchen with high-end white goods, blending convenience with contemporary aesthetics. The living and dining areas flow seamlessly onto private balconies, offering breathtaking vistas of the Arabian Gulf. The master bedrooms are designed as serene retreats, with en-suite bathrooms featuring sleek fixtures and refined detailing. Smart home technology and energy-efficient features enhance everyday living, while spacious layouts cater to both relaxation and entertainment, creating an unparalleled waterfront lifestyle. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

Thoughtfully planned layouts, clean architectural lines, and bright interiors create a welcoming atmosphere, with an emphasis on making the most of every space. Thoughtful layouts and coordinated interior details create comfortable spaces suited to modern lifestyles. Beyond its commercial significance, Jebel Ali offers access to residential communities, essential services, educational facilities, and recreational destinations. Its coastal setting adds to the area's appeal, while Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai Metro connections provide convenient links to other parts of the city. Residents can access Dubai's wider selection of shopping destinations, beaches, parks, and entertainment venues while benefiting from proximity to important employment and business hubs. With its contemporary residences, practical amenities, and strategic location, Azizi Lina presents an option for buyers seeking modern living in Dubai's southern corridor, including end-users and property investors.

description: Project general facts New Project is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Residents can choose from stylish studios, one-bedroom apartments in two thoughtful layouts and spacious two-bedroom homes, while ground-level retail units bring everyday convenience right to the doorstep. Life at the tower centres on a beautifully landscaped podium deck with a sparkling swimming pool, comfortable sunloungers, a shaded cabana and relaxed lounge seating surrounded by lush greenery. A bright, fully equipped gym with floor-to-ceiling glass overlooks the pool, making every workout feel energising and inspiring. Arrival is equally impressive, with a grand double-height glazed lobby beneath a stone canopy, a landscaped drop-off area and multi-level podium parking wrapped in a sculpted louvred facade. Every home is designed to feel light and open, with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the interiors with natural daylight. Private balconies with sleek glass balustrades extend the living space outdoors and create a perfect spot to unwind. Warm neutral tones, premium stone and elegant bronze accents carry the building's refined character from the facade all the way inside, delivering a truly polished and sophisticated living experience. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. title: Emaar Ocean Star
description:
Ocean Star is a residential development by Emaar Properties, located within Rashid Yachts & Marina at Mina Rashid, Dubai. The project comprises two residential buildings offering a selection of one, two and three-bedroom apartments, combining contemporary interiors with a waterfront setting and access to the wider marina community.
The development includes 154 residential apartments, comprising 58 one-bedroom, 76 two-bedroom and 20 three-bedroom homes. The apartments feature practical layouts, spacious living areas and private balconies or terraces, with a range of configurations to suit different household needs. The supplied floor plans cover 38 layout variations, with total apartment areas ranging from approximately 789.9 to 2,025 sq ft.
One-bedroom apartments offer efficient layouts with private outdoor space, while two-bedroom residences provide additional room for families and shared living. Three-bedroom apartments feature larger interiors and, in selected layouts, substantially larger balconies or terraces. The combination of indoor living space and private outdoor areas contributes to the development's residential appeal.
Ocean Star is designed around a waterfront lifestyle, with a signature canal pool, landscaped green spaces and recreational facilities. Residents can enjoy access to a gym, recreational courts, a community park and a boardwalk promenade. The surrounding community also provides access to marina facilities, retail and dining options, and nearby educational and healthcare facilities.
Located within Rashid Yachts & Marina, Ocean Star offers access to the waterfront promenade and the wider marina environment. Dubai International Airport is approximately 15 minutes away by car, while Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are around 20 minutes away. With its range of apartment sizes, waterfront setting and community facilities, Ocean Star offers an appealing option for end-users, families and investors seeking a home in Dubai's marina district.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

The Type 1 plan separates the bedroom from a combined living-and-dining room, then adds a dressing area, full bathroom and guest powder room. The arrival is deliberately composed. A guest powder room sits close to the entrance, allowing the private side of the suite to remain separate when entertaining. Beyond it, the living-and-dining room forms the social centre of the accommodation, with the balcony extending across the curved outer façade. The bedroom occupies its own zone and is supported by a dedicated dressing area and full bathroom. Both principal rooms are positioned against the balcony line, making the outdoor space and high-floor outlook central to the plan. The brochure identifies an approximately 4.2 by 4.4 metre living-and-dining room, a 3.8 by 5.0 metre bedroom, a 2.1 by 2.9 metre dressing area, a 4.0 by 2.3 metre bathroom and a 2.3 by 1.3 metre powder room. The balcony measures approximately 4.9 by 10.7 metres. At nearly 50 m², this outdoor area is a defining part of the Executive Suite rather than a token terrace. Dimensions are indicative and remain subject to the selected sale documents. This is a hotel suite, not a conventional self-catering apartment. The supplied plan includes a dining setting within the combined living room but shows no private kitchen and no separate dining room. Buyers should assess it on that basis: the accommodation prioritises a proper lounge, bedroom privacy, dressing space, two washroom functions and exceptional outdoor scale, while dining is delivered through the wider hotel environment. Project visuals propose a calm, polished interior language of warm timber, pale stone, tailored lighting and broad glazing. The separation between the social and private zones gives the suite a measured residential rhythm without losing its five-star hotel identity. Visuals communicate the intended design direction only; finishes, furniture, equipment and operating provisions must be verified against the contractual specification. The hotel amenity programme includes a rooftop swimming pool and pool bar, specialty restaurant, spa and sauna, gymnasium, business lounge and grand ballroom. A padel court, children's club and play areas, children's pool, outdoor cinema and barbecue areas extend the setting across leisure, wellness, business and family stays. RAK Central places the hotel between Ras Al Khaimah's commercial centre and its resort corridor. Al Hamra Mall is approximately five minutes away, Al Hamra Golf Club seven minutes away, Al Marjan Island eight minutes away and Wynn Al Marjan Island around ten minutes away. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is approximately fifteen minutes away, while Dubai International Airport is around forty-five minutes away. Drive times are indicative and depend on traffic. For an international buyer, the Executive Suite occupies the collection's deliberate middle position: the privacy of a genuine one-bedroom, the Hotel's highest floor for this layout and far more outdoor space than the Studio, without moving into the larger Presidential configuration. description: Beachfront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island in Umm Al-Quwain is a stunning haven that blends luxurious living with breathtaking natural surroundings. This exclusive community offers a range of upscale residences, including waterfront villas and elegant apartments, thoughtfully crafted for a sophisticated island lifestyle. Residents benefit from direct beach access, expansive green spaces, and world-class amenities such as an 18-hole golf course, eco-park, and water sports adventures. With its rich ecological diversity and cultural heritage, Siniyah Island provides a peaceful escape just 50 minutes from Dubai, perfectly balancing tranquility and urban convenience. Umm Al Quwain are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious lifestyle harmoniously integrated with natural beauty, featuring state-of-the-art residential units within multi-use towers ranging from 2 to 10 stories. The development is surrounded by pristine white sand beaches, lush mangroves, and a rich tapestry of unique wildlife. Community amenities include a recreational fishing deck, family-oriented golf course, event cabanas, al fresco dining, and luxury beach cabanas. A seawater lagoon is central to the community, providing facilities for non-motorized water sports such as snorkeling, paddleboarding, kayaking, and floating cinema experiences. Linear parks are equipped with yoga decks, wellness parks, and sports facilities like tennis and paddle courts, alongside skateboarding zones. Additional highlights include a yacht club, mosque, retail mall, public beach, and helicopter landing pad. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse with a gym, library lounge, steam and sauna rooms, and multipurpose spaces. The development also prioritizes sustainability with double-glazed façades, energy-efficient systems, and provisions for electric vehicle charging. The project features meticulously designed interiors that combine elegance with functionality, offering 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts and high-quality finishes. Each unit is equipped with fitted wardrobes and kitchens that include premium white goods such as an oven, gas hob and hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. The living and bedroom areas are adorned with porcelain tile flooring and finished with matte emulsion paint walls for a sleek yet cozy ambiance. The master bedrooms boast en-suite bathrooms, while all bathrooms and powder rooms are outfitted with premium-brand water closets, washbasins, and chrome-plated fittings. Kitchens feature high-quality reconstituted stone countertops and laminate or high-gloss PET-finished cabinets. The design emphasizes luxury and practicality, with concealed cisterns in bathrooms and carefully selected finishes throughout to enhance the overall living experience. UAQ-00004

description: At the summit of the five-star Radisson Blu Hotel RAK Central, this top-floor corner Presidential Suite expands the idea of a one-bedroom into 2,109.08 sq ft (195.94 m²) of private interior and outdoor space. The plan brings together a separate kitchen, formal dining room, private lounge and study, while two sweeping balconies open the accommodation to sea and community views. The suite is organised around a central arrival hall that establishes privacy from the moment of entry. A study creates a defined workspace near the entrance, while the kitchen and dining room occupy their own wing rather than being absorbed into the lounge. The central lounge is reserved for conversation and relaxation. On the opposite side, the bedroom forms a substantial private zone with its own seating area, dressing room and full bathroom. A guest powder room remains accessible without entering the bedroom suite. The proportions are exceptional for a one-bedroom hotel property. The internal suite extends to 1,558.94 sq ft (144.83 m²), with approximately 550.14 sq ft (51.11 m²) distributed across two balconies in this selected configuration. The brochure shows an approximately 4.1 by 1.7 metre kitchen, 5.8 by 4.4 metre dining room, 5.2 by 4.5 metre lounge and 1.9 by 2.5 metre study. The bedroom measures approximately 8.2 by 4.8 metres, supported by a 2.9 by 1.8 metre dressing room and a 4.4 by 2.9 metre bathroom. Dimensions are indicative and remain subject to the selected sale documents. The two curved balconies trace the suite's outer façade and are planned as separate outdoor settings rather than a single narrow ledge. One extends in front of the bedroom and private lounge; the other serves the main lounge and dining side. This creates several ways to use the outdoor space while preserving the distinction between private and social rooms. Project visuals propose a tailored contemporary interior of warm timber, pale stone, restrained colour and layered lighting. description: Ocean Crest is an elegant coastal residential development that brings together contemporary sophistication and the tranquillity of waterfront living. Thoughtfully designed to reflect the natural beauty of its surroundings, the residences feature a harmonious blend of soft textures, natural light, and timeless colour palettes. Every element is carefully considered to create an inviting atmosphere where modern aesthetics meet comfort, offering residents a peaceful retreat inspired by the rhythm of the sea. The development embraces a refined approach to residential living, with welcoming interiors and thoughtfully planned spaces that balance elegance with functionality. Living areas transition seamlessly into private spaces, creating a natural flow throughout each residence. Contemporary detailing, carefully selected materials, and a calming design philosophy contribute to an environment that feels both sophisticated and effortlessly comfortable, providing an ideal setting for relaxation and everyday living. Beyond the residences, Ocean Crest offers a curated selection of lifestyle amenities designed to enhance wellness, leisure, and relaxation. Dedicated wellness facilities and inviting recreational spaces create opportunities to unwind, recharge, and enjoy a balanced lifestyle. With its coastal-inspired atmosphere and emphasis on comfort, the development offers more than a home-it presents a lifestyle shaped by tranquillity, contemporary design, and the appeal of seaside living. Location Description and Benefits Dubai Islands is an emerging waterfront destination designed to bring together coastal living, contemporary residences, hospitality, and leisure within an expansive island setting. Comprising five interconnected islands, the master development features an extensive coastline, scenic beaches, landscaped open spaces, and thoughtfully planned residential and recreational districts. Its distinctive setting offers a refreshing alternative to the city's fast-paced urban environment while maintaining access to Dubai's established lifestyle and business destinations. The destination is envisioned as a comprehensive lifestyle community, with plans for luxury resorts, marinas, beachfront leisure, dining destinations, and retail experiences. Residents can enjoy opportunities for outdoor recreation, including beach activities, water sports, and yachting, alongside landscaped parks and spaces for relaxation. This combination of natural surroundings and lifestyle attractions contributes to the area's appeal for those seeking a contemporary waterfront address. Dubai Islands also benefits from road connections linking the island development to mainland Dubai, supporting access to key destinations across the city. Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and the traditional commercial districts around Deira are accessible by road, while public transport connectivity continues to develop alongside the wider area. Combining coastal scenery, evolving infrastructure, and an expanding collection of lifestyle attractions, Dubai Islands presents an appealing destination for those seeking modern seaside living in Dubai.

description: Elegant Flats Walking Distance of Metro in Al Jaddaf Dubai Situated at the northern gateway of the Al Jaddaf Waterfront, this high-profile project blends residential, commercial, and retail spaces into one vibrant destination. The strategic position provides an open, airy environment next to Dubai Creek, surrounded by low-rise developments that ensure permanent light and space. The unique dual-profile orientation delivers unblocked vistas in two distinct directions: northwest facing towards Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, and Zabeel, alongside southeast views stretching across Mohammed bin Rashid Library, Dubai Creek Harbour, and the peaceful waterfront. Dubai Festival City is 7 minutes away, the Museum of the Future takes 10 minutes, while Jumeirah Beach is a 17-minute drive. The residential interiors maximize functional space using open-plan concepts and sweeping floor-to-ceiling glass windows that frame the skyline while maintaining interior privacy. description: This is not a two-bedroom apartment with a generous balcony. It is a 3,302.26 sq ft (306.79 m²) private-pool residence whose outdoor space is larger than its entire interior. Set on the seventh floor of Aqua Arc, the corner plan combines sea and internal-landscape views with a remarkable 2,099.39 sq ft private terrace and an asking price of AED 8,558,998. The pool belongs to the residence and occupies the outer arc of the terrace. It is not several floors away within a shared amenity deck. That single distinction changes how the home can be used: the outdoor space becomes a private setting for quiet mornings, open-air dining and evenings hosted above Al Marjan Island. Inside, the 1,202.87 sq ft (111.75 m²) suite is planned as a complete two-bedroom home. The entrance creates a clear transition into the living areas, with a 2.0 by 2.5 metre kitchen connecting naturally to the 4.6 by 5.2 metre living and dining room. The curved frontage draws the eye toward the terrace, allowing the interior to remain visually connected with the pool and the changing outlook beyond it. The private accommodation sits away from the main social space. The principal bedroom measures 3.8 by 4.2 metres and is paired with a substantial 2.8 by 3.6 metre bathroom. The second bedroom measures 3.3 by 4.2 metres and is served by another full bathroom. A separate powder room keeps guest use away from the bedroom accommodation, while a dedicated laundry preserves the kitchen as part of the home's entertaining space. The terrace is the defining room. At approximately 195.04 m², it offers enough breadth to compose several outdoor zones instead of forcing every activity into one arrangement. There is scope for dining near the living room, a more relaxed lounge along the curved frontage and sun loungers beside the private pool. These are potential uses rather than included furnishings, but the physical proportions make each possible without compromising circulation. The seventh-floor corner position gives the residence two distinct outlooks. One aspect turns toward the sea; the other takes in Aqua Arc's internal landscape. The view therefore develops as one moves around the terrace rather than presenting a single fixed elevation. Together with the pool and the sweep of the architecture, that dual aspect gives the apartment a sense of privacy and occasion normally associated with a resort home. Aqua Arc's design is shaped by flowing façades, wave-inspired balconies and a restrained coastal palette. The interior concepts combine pale stone, warm timber and soft neutral tones, allowing the water and natural light to remain central to the experience. Project visuals show the intended design language; final materials, fixtures, appliances and furniture must follow the executed sale documents. The planned amenity programme includes indoor and outdoor fitness areas, walking trails, recreational lawns, barbecue facilities, a pool bar, steam and sauna facilities, and indoor and outdoor children's play areas. Beach access is also identified in the project material. Final access rights, operating arrangements and completion specifications remain subject to the governing documents. For an international second-home buyer, this residence offers the outdoor life of a private resort property within an apartment format. For a long-term purchaser, its proposition rests on rare, visible attributes rather than a forecast return: more than 306 m² of total space, a private-pool terrace larger than the interior, a seventh-floor corner position and two verified outlooks. description: Fior 1 is an exclusive waterfront residential development that brings together Dubai's rich maritime heritage and the elegance of contemporary coastal living. Set within the prestigious Rashid Yachts & Marina community, the development offers a collection of modern residences designed to embrace scenic marina views, natural light, and a sense of openness. Its striking architectural design combines clean lines with refined detailing, creating a sophisticated residential address where tranquillity, modernity, and waterfront charm come together. The development features a thoughtfully designed range of lifestyle amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and community living. Residents can enjoy swimming pools for adults and children, landscaped green spaces, dedicated fitness and yoga areas, and outdoor relaxation zones. Barbecue facilities and family-friendly recreational spaces create inviting settings for social gatherings, while carefully planned leisure areas offer peaceful retreats from the pace of city life. Every element contributes to a balanced lifestyle where relaxation and recreation exist in perfect harmony. The residences showcase contemporary interiors defined by elegant finishes, soothing neutral tones, and carefully selected materials. Positioned along the Dubai Water Canal on Marasi Drive, the area, where the flats are located, offers excellent views of the city's most iconic landmarks. It also provides a peaceful and private living environment. Its prime location ensures quick access to Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, DIFC, and major lifestyle destinations. The area is ideal for those seeking both exclusivity and connectivity. Situated along the Dubai Water Canal on Marasi Drive, these offer easy access to the city's most prestigious destinations. The flats are located 7 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 10 minutes from Downtown Dubai, 15 minutes from DIFC and Jumeirah, and 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport. Surrounded by waterfront views and iconic landmarks, the project combines central connectivity with serene living. It is designed as an ultra-luxury residential development, offering a rare fusion of nature, architecture, and well-being. Designed by renowned architect Zane Tetere-Sulce, the project reflects the principles of biophilic and neuro-architecture, where design directly enhances mental, emotional, and physical well-being. Amenities of the project include indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a full-service spa with a sauna, hammam, ice bath, and treatment rooms, as well as yoga and meditation spaces, a private cinema, a residents' lounge, and curated social areas. Meanwhile, children's zones and wellness-focused communal spaces ensure a holistic living environment for all ages.The project holds LEED Platinum, WELL Platinum, and WiredScore Platinum certifications, reflecting its commitment to environmental responsibility, healthy living, and advanced digital infrastructure. The flats are a limited collection of ultra-luxury residences, including spacious two- and three-bedroom units, exclusive duplexes, and a one-of-a-kind penthouse. The flats feature private elevator access, expansive terraces with optional pools and waterfalls, floor-to-ceiling glazing, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions. The interiors are crafted with premium natural materials, custom joinery, and high-end finishes, complemented by fully equipped kitchens with top-tier European appliances and spa-inspired bathrooms finished in natural stone. description: Comfortable Apartments in a High Brand Value Project In Downtown Dubai Located in one of Dubai's most prestigious districts, the project sits just moments from Downtown Dubai, along the Business Bay waterfront. This prime address combines the calm atmosphere of the Dubai Canal with the vibrant city life of Downtown, offering residents a perfect balance between central connectivity and refined urban living. With easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road, DIFC, and major business hubs, the location is ideal for both lifestyle and professional convenience. Thanks to its central position, reaching Dubai's key attraction points is quick and effortless. From the , Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall are approximately 9 minutes away, Dubai International Airport (DXB) can be reached in around 15 minutes, and the Business Bay Metro Station is only a short distance away. Popular destinations such as Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina are also easily accessible by car, making the area highly suitable for a dynamic city lifestyle. Tekce offers a hospitality inspired living experience with a strong focus on comfort, wellness, and community. Residents can enjoy an impressive range of social amenities, including an infinity swimming pool, temperature controlled pools, state of the art fitness facilities, spa and wellness areas, yoga and relaxation decks, landscaped leisure spaces, BBQ areas, as well as children's pools and play zones. Purchasing a home in or near Downtown Dubai means owning property in one of the city's most iconic and consistently high demand locations, known for its global appeal, limited supply, and strong long-term value. Buying property in Dubai represents more than just homeownership it is an entry into a world of luxury living combined with solid investment potential. Centrally located residences with premium amenities continue to attract both end users and tenants throughout the year. Living close to Downtown places residents near world class dining, shopping, and landmark attractions, while investors benefit from a prime location, strong rental demand, and a lifestyle driven market that supports sustainable capital growth. title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, Palm Jebel Ali and Dubai Parks and Resorts are among the major destinations within easy reach, and the wider Dubai South area also includes logistics and business zones that bring jobs close to home for many residents. The district appeals to buyers looking for an accessible entry point into a growing part of Dubai. Compact studios and two-bedroom apartments here suit young professionals, couples and small families who want a quiet residential setting, as well as investors interested in rental demand linked to the airport, the logistics hub and the continued development of Expo City Dubai. Contact: Mayank

description: The Arabian Gulf does not offer this view to everyone. At Samana Ocean Crest, it comes with your morning coffee. Fifty-six residences. One island. No compromise. Developed by Samana Developers - ranked fifth among Dubai's highest off-plan sellers by volume in the first half of 2025, with a portfolio valued at over AED 17 billion - Ocean Crest represents the developer's most considered coastal statement to date. Positioned on Dubai Islands, the Nakheel-masterplanned destination that redefines what island living means in this city, the project rises across eight residential floors with a discipline of scale that most developers would not allow themselves: just 56 residences, each one crafted with the attention that only boutique numbers permit. Many homes feature private terrace pools, interiors finished in warm natural stone, wood, and glass, and layouts calibrated around panoramic sea and skyline perspectives. Samana has built its reputation on delivering resort-style living as a lived experience rather than a marketing promise - and Ocean Crest is where that philosophy meets the Gulf itself. THE EXPERIENCE: Life at Ocean Crest operates at the cadence of the sea. Mornings open to the Arabian Gulf with no obstruction, afternoons unfold across a resort-grade amenity landscape, and evenings carry the particular stillness that only island addresses can offer. This is not urban living softened by a view. It is coastal living, fully committed. Private terrace pools - select residences with direct pool access from your own outdoor space Infinity pool and sun deck - a skyline-facing water environment designed for unhurried days Yoga studios and wellness spaces - dedicated areas for restoration alongside the water's edge Spa, sauna, and steam rooms - a full wellness facility integrated into the building's daily rhythm Children's splash pad and family zones - thoughtfully separated spaces for every generation Landscaped gardens and jogging tracks - green corridors woven into the island environment 24/7 concierge and artistic lobby - a resident arrival experience that sets the register from the first step THE INVESTMENT CASE: Dubai Islands is one of the few remaining large-scale waterfront destinations in Dubai where early capital allocation still carries meaningful upside - a Nakheel-developed master community with confirmed infrastructure, beach access, and a pipeline of hospitality and retail that will anchor long-term demand. Ocean Crest's boutique scale of 56 residences operates as a natural scarcity lever in a market where oversupply is the persistent structural risk. Samana's 86% foreign investor demand ratio confirms the international conviction behind the developer's product - and a freehold title on a beachfront island address, at a confirmed entry point of AED 2.2M, positions this well within reach of the buyer profile that this location will continue to attract. With handover in Q3 2028 and a 20/70/10 payment plan, the capital deployment is structured to carry investors through the community's most active development phase. WHO THIS IS FOR: This is for those who have spent enough time in landlocked buildings and have decided, with some finality, that the water is non-negotiable. People who want their Dubai address to signal something more specific than premium - something coastal, considered, and genuinely rare at this scale. Buyers who understand the arithmetic of boutique beachfront freehold on an emerging island master plan, and who also simply want to swim in their own pool on a Tuesday morning with nothing but the Gulf in front of them. Ocean Crest. Fifty-six chances to own the edge of the island.

description: Holm Central: furnished 2-bedroom apartment in Jumeirah Garden City offering approximately 98 sq m of space within a new residential development by Holm Developments. The residence features two separate bedrooms, a dedicated staff room, one parking space and interiors designed around natural light, quality finishes and restrained contemporary forms. Residents will have access to a swimming pool, children's pool, landscaped gardens, gym, yoga and meditation areas, wellness zone with a water feature, sauna, steam rooms, children's indoor and outdoor spaces, open-air relaxation areas, outdoor cooking zones, rooftop terraces and a rooftop viewing deck. The payment plan is structured as 35/65 , with 5% payable on booking, 30% during construction and the remaining 65% on handover. A key advantage of Holm Central is the combination of a spacious 2-bedroom layout with a staff room, extensive shared amenities and a central Jumeirah Garden City location. title: Damac Chic Tower
description:
Chic Tower is a DAMAC development in Business Bay, set on the Dubai Canal. The tower rises from a ground floor and five podium levels through 36 residential floors to a stepped roof, with undulating terraces that take their shape from the canal's waves. Its turquoise theme reflects the aesthetic of jeweller de GRISOGONO. The building holds around 450 homes: studios from 411 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments from 610 sq ft, two-bedroom apartments from 1,145 sq ft and a handful of three- and four-bedroom residences starting at 4,998 sq ft.

Homes are delivered unfurnished with fully equipped kitchens. The three- and four-bedroom units each have a planted terrace with an infinity pool, a personal gym and a projection screen. Wellness shapes the shared spaces: the lobby has workout benches and weights, and the podium holds seven baths, including hot, cold, salt and mud baths, a spa, a beauty bar and an outdoor calisthenics gym. Pools, cabanas, a juice bar, playgrounds, football pitches, party areas and a 180-metre lazy river complete it. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and DIFC are close by, and Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute drive.

Business Bay and Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall metro stations are both nearby. The tower includes just three three-bedroom homes and one four-bedroom home. DAMAC, active in the region since 2002, reported around 42,000 homes delivered as of December 2021. The payment plan is 20% on booking, 20% during construction and 60% on handover, which is expected in Q4 2026. The project is registered with the Dubai Land Department, with its escrow account held at Mashreq Bank.

title: Mina Jebel Ali, Dubai
description: Raw District is a premium mixed-use development. Conceived as an "urban lifestyle philosophy" rather than a conventional residential project, the development is designed as a dynamic cultural hub where living, working, and social interaction seamlessly intersect. Its architecture embraces a raw, minimalistic aesthetic with open, adaptable spaces that prioritize functionality, movement, and continuous evolution.The project offers a wide range of fully furnished residences, including studios, 1- to 3-bedroom apartments, alongside office and retail spaces. Raw District stands out for its extensive and unconventional amenities, curated to foster creativity, collaboration, and community engagement. Rather than traditional leisure facilities, the project introduces concept-driven spaces such as creative studios, podcast rooms, co-working hubs, wellness zones, indoor and outdoor cinemas, and curated dining experiences. Signature features like the District Table, design labs, and maker spaces create an ecosystem where residents and professionals can connect, create, and evolve - forming a vibrant, ever-changing environment tailored to a new generation of urban living. Interiors follow a clean, stripped-back design language focused on efficiency and comfort, featuring open-plan kitchens, integrated appliances, smart storage solutions, and smart home technology. The layouts are thoughtfully designed to support modern urban lifestyles, balancing practicality with understated elegance. A strong emphasis is placed on furnishing and interior detailing, with residences delivered fully furnished in a refined, minimalist style that prioritizes clarity, usability, and quiet sophistication. Additional features such as acoustic treatments, smart home integration, and high-quality fittings further elevate everyday living, ensuring each space feels cohesive, functional, and effortlessly livable. Location description and benefits Jebel Ali is a renowned district in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, strategically set along the Arabian Gulf coastline. At its heart lies Jebel Ali Port, one of the world's largest container hubs, which has cemented the area's global significance in trade and commerce. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. This integration of trade, business, and residential life makes Jebel Ali a distinctive and multifaceted destination.

Its bold architectural identity distinguishes DG1 from many neighbouring residential developments while providing residents with elegant communal areas and thoughtfully planned living spaces. Set on the second floor of Aqua Arc on Al Marjan Island, this residence spans 1,217.93 sq ft (113.15 m²), combining an 850.99 sq ft interior with a remarkable 366.94 sq ft private balcony. More than thirty per cent of the property is dedicated to outdoor space, giving the apartment a scale and openness that its bedroom count alone does not reveal. Inside, the plan feels like a complete home rather than a compact holiday unit. The 3.0 by 2.2 metre kitchen leads naturally into a 5.8 by 4.0 metre living and dining room. This principal space is broad enough to accommodate defined lounge and dining settings, then opens directly onto the curved balcony for an effortless indoor-outdoor sequence. The bedroom measures 5.1 by 3.9 metres, allowing the sleeping area to retain a calm, well-proportioned character. It is supported by a generous 3.0 by 2.6 metre full bathroom. A separate guest powder room keeps visitors away from the private accommodation, while the dedicated laundry removes day-to-day utility from the kitchen. Together, these supporting spaces make the apartment far more suitable for extended stays than a typical one-bedroom layout. The balcony is the defining feature. At approximately 34.09 m², it has the proportions for open-air dining, a comfortable lounge arrangement and quiet private use without forcing every function into one narrow strip. Its curved edge follows Aqua Arc's wave-inspired architecture and gives the home a genuine outdoor room rather than a token balcony. The residence carries a community outlook. It is therefore best suited to a buyer who values interior scale, usable outdoor space and a calmer inward-facing position over a direct-sea premium. That distinction should be clear from the outset: the value here comes from proportion and liveability, not from an overstated view claim. Al Marjan Island places the residence within Ras Al Khaimah's established waterfront and hospitality corridor. description: Volta by DAMAC Properties is a premium residential development situated in the heart of Downtown Dubai, offering an exceptional blend of contemporary architecture, urban sophistication, and upscale living. The development features a diverse collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments alongside super-luxury three- and four-bedroom residences, catering to a range of lifestyle preferences. Designed to complement Dubai's dynamic cityscape, the tower combines elegant residential spaces with modern functionality, further enhanced by a dedicated 13-storey podium parking structure for added convenience. The development offers a thoughtfully curated lifestyle with dedicated recreational spaces and leisure amenities, including a rooftop amenity area atop the separate podium parking structure. Its prime Downtown Dubai location places residents within easy reach of prestigious shopping destinations, fine dining establishments, entertainment venues, and renowned cultural landmarks. This combination of urban connectivity, premium facilities, and contemporary residential design creates an appealing living environment for those seeking a sophisticated city lifestyle. The interiors are finished with carefully selected materials and contemporary detailing to create a refined and functional living experience. Living and dining areas feature elegant marble flooring, painted walls, and selected accent finishes, while bedrooms incorporate porcelain tile flooring, built-in wardrobes, and thoughtfully designed feature walls in the master bedroom. Bathrooms are appointed with stone countertops, quality sanitary ware, mirrors, shower enclosures, and modern fittings. Kitchens feature sleek cabinetry, stone countertops, stainless-steel sinks, porcelain flooring, and integrated appliances, including a cooker, extractor hood, refrigerator, and washing machine. Delivered unfurnished, the residences provide a premium finished foundation that allows homeowners to personalise their interiors according to their individual tastes. Location Description and Benefits Downtown Dubai is one of the city's most prestigious and vibrant destinations, renowned for its iconic skyline, world-class attractions, and cosmopolitan atmosphere. Home to celebrated landmarks such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and the spectacular Dubai Fountain, the district offers an exceptional combination of luxury shopping, fine dining, entertainment, and cultural experiences. Its dynamic environment attracts residents and visitors throughout the year, making it one of Dubai's most recognisable lifestyle and residential destinations. The neighbourhood offers a sophisticated urban lifestyle, with an extensive selection of luxury residences, premium hotels, stylish cafés, and high-end leisure destinations. Beyond its commercial appeal, Downtown Dubai provides a vibrant residential environment where everyday conveniences and entertainment are seamlessly integrated. From designer boutiques and international restaurants to scenic promenades and lively public spaces, the district caters to those who appreciate a connected and contemporary way of living. Strategically positioned near Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Al Wasl, and Business Bay, Downtown Dubai benefits from excellent connectivity to key commercial districts, residential communities, and major destinations across the city. Its accessible transport links and proximity to essential amenities make it particularly attractive to professionals, frequent travellers, and residents seeking convenient urban living. Combining a prestigious address, landmark surroundings, and a thriving lifestyle scene, Downtown Dubai continues to stand out as one of the city's most desirable destinations for luxury residential living.

title: Union Takaya
description:
Takaya is being developed by Union Properties beside Dubai Autodrome in Motor City, near Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It combines three towers: Takaya Tower rises 29 floors above ground, basement and podium levels, while Symphony and Harmony each have 19. Townhouses and villas sit around a shared podium, for a total of 744 apartments, 39 townhouses and five villas plus retail units. Apartments run from studios to four bedrooms, with one- to four-bedroom layouts of 831 sq ft to 2,339 sq ft, and the four-bedroom townhouses are set over three levels with a roof terrace.

Homes are handed over semi-furnished, with soft pastel interiors and kitchens fitted with Siemens appliances; many layouts add a maid's room and walk-in wardrobes. The 24 shared amenities include lap, recreational and children's pools, three gyms, two squash courts, a paddle tennis court, a golf simulator, a cinema room, co-working spaces, a children's day care and a sky garden. Parking is provided for 1,203 cars, 100 of them enabled for EV charging. A landscaped retail plaza sits at street level, and Motor City's gardens, cycle paths and the Dubai Outdoor Kartdrome are nearby.

Union Properties, founded in 1987 and publicly listed, is the developer behind Motor City, Dubai Autodrome and Uptown Mirdif, and has delivered more than 10,000 units in Dubai. Takaya adds a broad spread of apartment sizes and a limited number of townhouses and villas to this established community between major highways. The payment plan asks for 5% on booking and 15% during construction, with the remaining 80% due on handover, expected in Q4 2027.

Comprising six distinctive towers delivered across two phases, the development presents an exclusive collection of one, two, and three-bedroom residences designed to complement modern urban lifestyles. With elegant architectural details, sophisticated interiors, and panoramic sea views, it offers a unique residential experience in one of Dubai's emerging waterfront destinations. The development features an impressive selection of wellness, leisure, and sports-inspired amenities designed to create a resort-style atmosphere. Residents can enjoy infinity swimming pools, aerial yoga spaces, jogging tracks, outdoor fitness facilities, and dedicated wellness experiences, including cryotherapy, water treatment tunnels, rain therapy areas, and forest relaxation pods. The area features specialised facilities, including shipyards, dry docks, marine equipment suppliers, and maritime service zones. Educational and professional training facilities further contribute to its role as a centre for maritime expertise, supporting industry development and innovation. Alongside its commercial significance, the district's waterfront setting adds to its appeal as an emerging location for contemporary residential developments. Its strategic position provides convenient road access to established parts of Dubai, including Port Rashid, Downtown Dubai, and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). Connections to major transport routes and nearby port facilities also support access to key commercial districts and international trade networks. Dubai Maritime City's combination of waterfront surroundings, commercial importance, and connectivity makes it an increasingly distinctive part of Dubai's urban landscape.
